lines.en: label beachfive11:
scene chikabeachtouka1
: Haaah...
: This sucks...
: He didn’t even come look for me.
: Is it the hair?...I bet he hates it. I should have asked him first. Dumb idea, Chika. Fucking stupid idea. What were you thinking?

Chika Chosokabe had been having a tough time lately. So tough, in fact, that she’d taken to tossing grains of sand over her shoulder as part of the world’s longest game of “He loves me, he loves me not.”
When there was no sand left in front of her, she’d finally have an answer. But by then there would be a mountain so large behind her that it would very likely spill forward and bury her completely.
Right now, that wouldn’t be entirely unwelcome. She was smitten beyond all belief — and the one thing she wanted in this very moment was for the one person she wants to just acknowledge her.
He had barely done that at all lately. He’d been nothing short of a changed man following his time in a makeshift prison. But what she didn’t know is that this was proof of his love.
What she didn’t know is that the man she wishes she could tie a rope around felt guilty being near her because it made him feel like he was betraying someone else.
He thought that if he could just stay away, Chika’s feelings would begin to fade. But what he did not know is just how tenacious this girl was.
Chika Chosokabe could take a beating — both sexually and mentally. And the amount of pain she could withstand in both respects would make anyone envious.
But of course that didn’t mean she was fine.
This wasn’t “fine” at all. This was the most hopeless she’d felt since her mother passed away — and it was all for someone who didn’t even deserve it.
Part of her knew that. Part of her knew that she could find someone else whenever she wanted. But she didn’t want someone else. She wanted him.
So she’d wait and wait and wait and wait, telling herself every day that this would be the day he’d let her back into his life. But no matter how long she waited, that day never came.
And she was starting to worry it never would.
She was starting to worry that someone else had sunk their teeth into him...that he’d gotten bored of her. But she cared less about who that was right now and more about how to win him back.
She could clean up the mess later. She could scare someone away if she had to.
Anyone but Ami, that is. Chika had resigned herself to the fact that if anything were to happen to Ami, it would have to be something she physically did. But again...first came winning him back.
If only she knew that persistence was one of his greatest weaknesses. If only these childish feelings stopped getting in the way of her beating him down until he admits how he really feels about her.
Then they could laugh and kiss and make love and he could tell her all about how she’s the echo of a life he’s always longed for.
But instead she’s here with her feet in the sand and her heart in her stomach as someone manages to sneak up on her without her so much as noticing.
: Chika?...
scene chikabeachtouka2
: What are you doing out here all alone? Rin was asking about you just a moment ago.
: Oh...hey, Touka. Don’t mind me. I’m just out here being miserable.
: May...I ask why? Or would you prefer to keep it to yourself?

: You can ask. But fair warning, it’ll probably turn into a big thing where I just rant and complain and make myself look like an idiot for the next hour. So run away now if you want to save yourself.
scene chikabeachtouka3
: I have time. Yasu’s with Molly tonight, so I’m free to listen to anyone who wants to make themselves sound like an idiot for any amount of hours.
: Besides, there’s something I’ve wanted to ask you as well. But not until you’re done getting all of that misery out of your system.
scene clearnightsky
: Thanks, Touka...but, fair warning part two, it involves boys.
: As in...multiple?
: Mmm...more like zero right now. Ideally one, but currently zero. And not multiple unless this specific boy wanted to get really freaky and it was only a one time thing that he was also involved in.
scene chikabeachtouka4
: Now please stop me before my hormones spiral further out of control and I forever taint your pure heart with a more vivid description of exactly what would happen if-
: Silence, peasant. You are in the presence of royalty.
scene chikabeachtouka5
: Thank you. I’m not sure if classism was really necessary though.
: Apologies. Everyone always used to shut their mouth when my mother would say that, so it was the first thing I thought of to make you do the same.
: Now tell me, what’s going on with you and Sensei?
: All I said was “boy.” I never said it was him. But for the sake of the conversation, we can pretend that it is. So I will now say “Sensei” instead of “boy” just to make sure I don’t confuse you.
: I’m very grateful that you’d do such a thing for me, Chika. Thank you.
scene chikabeachtouka6
: Touka, I’m so confused. Like...what am I supposed to do if my boyfriend never wants to spend any time with me anymore? How do I make him...want to do that again?
: Do you really think I’m the one to ask such a question? I’d rarely even associated with males before high school. And since then it’s been almost exclusively teachers.
: Yeah, but you’re smart and pretty and I’m sure you must have had to fend off at least a dozen confessions at your old school.
: Well, you shouldn’t be as no such thing has ever happened to me.
scene chikabeachtouka7
: Not even once? Really?
: I believe...intimidating is the word I used to hear in regard to my presence?
: I can’t imagine many boys would fall for a girl whose parents could have them killed at a moment’s notice.
scene chikabeachtouka8
: Well, at least I’m not alone in being completely unapproachable.
: You’re far from unapproachable, Chika. I’m sure it’s just a misunderstanding.
: Then it’s the longest fucking misunderstanding ever. Sorry for the language.
: Please don’t apologize for not censoring yourself around me. I’m not your mother.
: I wish you were.
scene chikabeachtouka9
: Many do.
: No, I just mean...this is the exact sort of situation my mom would have been perfect for. Figuring this out on my own sucks. Nothing works. I’m so...fucking lost.
scene chikabeachtouka10
: My mother is there if you really need her, Chika. She’s told you this before, hasn’t she?
: Yeah...and honestly, I’ve been thinking of calling her and stuff. But, like...she’s always busy. And I feel bad about dragging her into this stuff when it’ll all probably sound dumb to her.
: I can assure that wouldn’t be the case at all. But seeing as she’s not here right now, I do hope I can be a suitable replacement. We are very similar, you know.
: Yeah...I do have a hard time shaking the fact that you’re my classmate, but I guess you two are really similar apart from that.
: What do you think she would do in my shoes, Touka? How would Tsubasa handle it if a boy she was dating just...started phasing her out?
: Chika...I’m not sure you actually want to hear the answer to that question.
: Why wouldn’t I? I’ll take anything at this point.
: No. You’ll take anything that will help. Hearing actual advice about what a strong woman would do when faced with such an issue will only scare you. I don’t want to do that.
scene chikabeachtouka11
: Scare me?...
: That’s right.
: So...I’m screwed? Am I just a step or two away from being dumped now? Is that what’s going on? There’s nothing I can do?
: It’s less what you can do and more what you should do.
: Can you just put it bluntly? I’m bad at using my brain when I’m sad.
: How about I ask you a question instead? Chika...do you think you deserve to be treated this way?
: I mean...no. I think I’m a great girlfriend. But I have no idea what Sensei thinks. What if he doesn’t see me that way?
: If he doesn’t see you that way, is he truly the man you want to be with? Or do you think it would be better for you if he were to “phase you out?”
scene chikabeachtouka12
: Being phased out is the last thing I want. That’s the worst possible outcome. Just thinking about it makes me want to break down in tears. I have to avoid that by any means possible.
: So you’ll continue to subject yourself to something clearly torturing you all for a chance to be with him?
scene chikabeachtouka13
: Mhm...
: Chika...forgive me, but that is so incredibly stupid.
scene chikabeachtouka14
: It’s not, though! I love him! I’d do anything for him!
scene chikabeachtouka15
: But how long will you do anything for? If you’ve been chasing his shadow to no avail for months on end, wouldn’t it make more sense to focus on someone who would value your time?
: Our lives are far too short to waste on those who don’t want us.
: So you think...he doesn’t want me anymore?...
: Chika...we are talking about a man in his thirties who does not yet even know what he wants out of life, let alone romance. We can’t expect him to always make sense.
: And if that is not something you’re comfortable with, wouldn’t it be smarter to just...move on?
scene chikabeachtouka16
: Of course it would be smarter! But I wouldn’t have started seeing him in the first place if being “smart” was something I cared about here!
: That’s not entirely true...Smart as you are, you’re still young. We both are. It’s expected for us to be impulsive and...make poor decisions at this age.
: But just because you make a poor decision doesn’t mean it needs to become an albatross. You can shoot it down whenever you like.
: What’s an albatross?
: It’s a...bird. Forgive me for the dated analogy. I’m just trying to tell you that-
: Things like this will continue to happen so long as you stay with him...So that’s something you must be prepared for.
scene chikabeachtouka17
: Is this really the type of girl you are, Chika? One who sits alone on the beach, venting about her problems? Because I could have sworn you were more proactive than that.
: I could have sworn that, out of anyone, you would be the type to run that man down until he has no choice but to speak to you. Is that not the case? Have you changed as well?
: I want to run him down...I really do.
: Then why are you here? You’ve already figured out he’s at the beach, yes? He’s readily available. Go to him.
scene chikabeachtouka18
: But, Touka...
: I’m scared...
: Of what?...
: Of what I’ll find out...
scene chikabeachtouka19
: Like...what if there’s someone else now? What if that’s why he’s avoiding me?! I’ve been...there have been some flags lately. Maybe longer than lately. I don’t know. But there are flags.
: And I...have no idea what I’d do if...that’s the truth. I love him so much. I’ve been so loyal. And I thought he was too, but- no. No, I don’t know he’s not yet. This is crazy talk, right? Right?
scene chikabeachtouka20
: Tell me I’m being crazy, Touka. Tell me it’s all in my head. It’s all in my head, right?! He’d never actually cheat on me. Right? He loves me! He’s said it a million times!
: And I’m sure he meant it, but...
: Love can be a complicated thing.
: I’m not sure if there are any two people in the world with the same definition of that word.
: B...But even if I do run him down, he probably won’t even talk to me! Why won’t he let me share this pain with him if there’s so fucking much of it?!
: Have you considered that maybe he’s just trying to protect you?
: Of course! But he doesn’t have to! I can take it! The two of us can work through it together!
: But if...if there’s someone else...
scene chikabeachtouka21
: Touka...I am so fucking scared that he’d share his pain with someone other than me...
: And so the last thing I want to do is annoy him because I don’t want that to be the tipping point that makes him throw me away altogether.
: Well...
: Let me just say that I don’t know Sensei as well as you, so feel free to take this with a grain of salt-
: But I highly doubt he would ever just throw you away. For all you know, you could be far more important to him than you even understand.
: So I say go annoy him if you’re positive he’s the one you want. But only if you’re positive- for good things don’t come to those who wait. They come to those who act.
scene chikabeachtouka22
: If there is someone else...
: What am I supposed to do if it’s someone I know?
: What would you want to do?
: Throw them into the back of a trunk and drive off a cliff.
: You probably shouldn’t do that...
: You asked.
: I did, didn’t I?...
: I really wish my mom was here. Or Tsubasa.
: Yes, I’m beginning to think my mother would have done a better job at this than I did.
: She’s just...a lot more gentle. But I’m sure you’ll be great at stuff like this when you have a daughter one day.
scene chikabeachtouka23
: Thank you, Chika...I’m sure you will as well. Though, I suppose you’re already a bit of a mother when it comes to Chinami. And...even Yumi to a slightly lesser extent.
: I’d like an actual daughter too one day. Sensei will take some convincing, though. If he doesn’t dump me, I mean.
: Just go talk to him...that’s the best advice I can give.
scene chikabeachtouka24
: Maybe after you’re done. You had something you wanted to ask me about too, right?
scene chikabeachtouka25
: Did I say that?
: Girl, it’s fine. I’ve done nothing but ramble on this whole time. It’s your turn to come to me. You’ve earned it.
: Yes, but I’m not entirely sure the subject I wanted to ask you about is appropriate given everything we just discussed and how...damaged your current mental state is.
: Touka. Ask me your fucking question.
: Well...okay. But it’s extremely and contextually inappropriate.
: I think I can handle it.
: Then...
scene chikabeachtouka26
: How do you have sex with a boy?
: You...
: You don’t know...how sex works?
scene chikabeachtouka27
: O-Of course I know how it works! I’ve just never...done it before...
: So I don’t know if there’s something specific that...boys like or...if there’s anything I should do. And I know that you’re experienced, so...
: Are you...going to sleep with somebody?
scene chikabeachtouka28
: Well...eventually. Though I’m...not quite sure when given the...current....political climate. But...I suppose I should learn. For when it...actually happens.
scene chikabeachtouka29
: I told you it was inappropriate!
: Sorry, it’s just cute seeing you like this. We’ve never had real “girl talk” before. I’d be more than happy to teach you about sex, Touka.
: And I’d be more than happy to learn!
scene black
: Okay! Then, first thing’s first, are you an S or an M?
: F...Female?...
: Mh...pffffft! Hahahaha! Female?!
: D...Don’t laugh at me! That question wasn’t covered in any of the resource materials I was provided!
: Ohhhh man...Buckle up, sister.
: This might take a while...
And so Chika spends the next hour teaching Touka how to properly cuck her — a thing she definitely won’t regret later on in life.
